result.topic_en: Riemann sets up coordinates for the ether particles of a light ray, using the experimental fact that all colours of light travel at the same speed c, so that the motion propagating along the x-axis is described by d'Alembert-type wave equations with solutions f(x+ct)+f_1(x-ct).
